name: Hinduism
hook: Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, karma and the Ganges: the Hinduism clues in six.

facts.label: the Trimurti
facts.statement: Hinduism's three main gods are Brahma the creator, Vishnu the preserver and Shiva the destroyer.

facts.label: Vishnu's avatars
facts.statement: Vishnu's earthly incarnations include Kurma the tortoise, Rama and Krishna, his eighth avatar.

facts.label: the Vedas
facts.statement: The Vedas are Hinduism's oldest sacred books, dating from 1500-500 B.C.; the Rigveda, with 1,028 hymns in 10 books, is oldest.

facts.label: the Ganges
facts.statement: The Ganges is Hinduism's holy river; Varanasi, one of its seven holy cities, lines its banks.

facts.label: karma
facts.statement: Karma means "act": deeds in one life fix consequences in the next, an immutable law of cause and effect.

facts.label: Sanskrit
facts.statement: Sanskrit is the classical language of Hinduism, related to old European languages such as Latvian.

facts.label: Kumbh Mela and Shivaratri
facts.statement: Kumbh Mela draws tens of millions to bathe in sacred rivers; Maha Shivaratri falls on the 14th night of a March new moon.
